parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. This is the NextToken value from the previous API call. If there are no more results, do not specify this parameter.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- 30

- 50

- 100

The default value is 30.
